description: NaTaO₃Ta₂O₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibam space group. Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with eight equivalent TaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are four shorter (2.55 Å) and four longer (2.71 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ta sites. In the first Ta site, Ta is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted TaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent TaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent TaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent TaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.35 Å. In the second Ta site, Ta is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted TaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent TaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent TaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are four shorter (2.09 Å) and four longer (2.10 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ta atoms to form distorted ONaTa₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Ta₂ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent ONaTa₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂Ta₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONaTa₃ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ta atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ta₂ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONa₂Ta₂ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent ONaTa₃ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ta₂ tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent ONaTa₃ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Ta atoms.
